name: com.blitzreels/blitzreels
title: BlitzReels Video Editor
description: Create, edit, reframe, caption, organize, generate, and export short-form videos with BlitzReels.

tools.name: hooks_suggest
tools.description: Suggest text hooks, existing transcript sentences and visual ranges without editing the project. Defaults to three per layer, count 1-5. Times use project timeline seconds. Included with a daily workspace cap; never starts media analysis. Unsupported options are omitted.

tools.name: content_performance_list
tools.description: Read bounded existing provider-reported engagement in the selected workspace, sorted by views. Filters by format, account and publication window. Returns lifetime counters, saved watch metrics, capture/check times, availability, and saved Project/export lineage when known. includeDetails includes bounded retention and audience tables. Does not import new data, start monitoring or infer attributable leads, sales or revenue.

tools.name: video_storyboard_create
tools.description: Create a vertical video storyboard for the user-approved script in an existing project. Spends planning credits; returns scene narration, factual review notes, references and the production credit estimate. Does not generate images or animate video. Existing account access applies.

use_seamless_transitions.description: Chain each scene's clip into the next with end frames. Applies only to video models that support end frames.

genre.description: Genre pack id. GET /generation-options/faceless lists them in genres, with what each format needs in formats.

storyboard.description: Generate one approved storyboard sheet instead of per-scene keyframes and use it as the video reference. Implies multi_shot.

multi_shot.description: Let one video generation cover several timed shots and camera angles. Adjacent script blocks are grouped into takes.

clip_seconds.description: Target length of each multi-shot generation. Defaults to 15, or the model maximum when lower.

tools.name: video_storyboard_get
tools.description: Read one authorized storyboard revision, its scene and reference previews, estimate, approvals and bounded polling guidance. Refreshes signed previews. Complete means the editable timeline is assembled; use exports_start and exports_list for a downloadable MP4.

tools.name: video_storyboard_revise
tools.description: Create a new immutable draft from a known revision with selected scene, character or model changes. Preserves other scene definitions; requires review and production approval again. Does not generate media or overwrite an approved revision.

shots.description: Replaces the scene's shots. Durations are scaled to fit the scene exactly.

end_frame.description: Where the clip ends. Null removes the end frame. Needs a video model that supports end frames.

source.description: edit_of_start edits the scene's approved keyframe as edit_prompt says; next_scene_start ends on the next scene's keyframe.

start_frame.description: previous_last_frame starts the clip on the last frame of the previous scene's clip.

style_anchor_prompt.description: Self-contained prompt for the single reference frame that locks rendering medium, palette, lighting, and grain for every scene. No characters, no text, no interfaces.

tools.name: video_storyboard_approve
tools.description: After showing the storyboard and its credit estimate, confirmApproved=true starts production of reference images and scene keyframes. Spends existing credits. This stage produces reviewable previews, not animated videos.

tools.name: video_assets_approve
tools.description: After the user approves the generated previews and animation cost, confirmApproved=true starts scene animation, narration and editable timeline assembly. Can replace the project's generated timeline and spend existing credits. Follow the revision and then export the finished project.

tools.name: video_storyboard_asset_regenerate
tools.description: Replace the identified preview after user approval of the new credit cost. A scene_keyframe changes one keyframe; a character_anchor refreshes its dependent keyframes; a style_anchor refreshes every keyframe. Preserves unaffected previews. Does not regenerate an already finished video shot.

asset_type.description: storyboard regenerates the sheet on storyboard plans; style_anchor regenerates the shared style reference and everything built on it; character_anchor requires character_id and refreshes dependent keyframes or the sheet; scene_keyframe requires scene_index and also redoes that scene's edited end frame; scene_end_frame requires scene_index and redoes only the edited end frame.

tools.name: recording_sets_list
tools.description: Read bounded camera and screen recording sets in the selected workspace with status, duration and alignment warnings.

tools.name: recording_sets_get
tools.description: Read one camera and screen recording set, its primary speaker, content windows, alignment and warnings. Separate audio-only tracks are not supported.

tools.name: recording_sets_create
tools.description: Create an empty camera and screen recording set in the explicit workspace. Requires existing recording-set access; does not import files or start processing.

tools.name: recording_sets_track_attach
tools.description: Attach one existing authorized video asset as a camera or screen track. Specify the main speaker when known; alignment happens during finalization.

tools.name: recording_sets_finalize
tools.description: Finalize the collected camera and screen tracks and queue analysis. Can spend existing transcription credits. Inspect returned alignment and warnings before clipping.

tools.name: recording_sets_clips_create
tools.description: Produce a batch from a ready synchronized camera and screen recording, with optional clip count, maximum duration and caption look. Preserves readable screen context through the existing layout pipeline. Can spend existing credits; follows clips_get with the returned batch_id.

tools.name: clip_share_get
tools.description: Read whether the source video's clip share page is public and which clips are visible. Does not publish content.

tools.name: clip_share_publish
tools.description: Make the selected source video's clip page public with reviewed title, description and explicit download permission. Requires confirmPublicSharing=true from the user. Returns the verified public URL; no social network post is made.

tools.name: clip_share_unpublish
tools.description: Disable public access to the selected clip page. Changes an existing publication; preserves private projects and exports.

tools.name: clip_share_visibility_set
tools.description: Show or hide one identified clip on an existing public review page after explicit user confirmation. Preserves the other clips and private project data.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List the user's BlitzReels projects with status, duration, and basic metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (1-50)

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: projects_get
tools.description: Get details for one BlitzReels project, including timeline summary, clips, captions, and current recovery state with an app path and next read tool.

projectId.description: The project ID to get details for. UUID string.

tools.name: projects_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a project with shared source media and copied timeline, captions, settings and framing. Returns clip_id for copied clip projects. Reuse idempotencyKey only with identical inputs.

tools.name: projects_inspect
tools.description: Read bounded project context for editing, including timeline items, media assets, transcripts, captions, and stable IDs.

mode.description: Bounded project context view to return.

search.description: Optional media search when mode is assets or full.

tools.name: exports_list
tools.description: List exports with render status and progress. Completed exports include a signed download URL. Pass exportId to return one export.

projectId.description: Filter exports by project ID. UUID string.

exportId.description: Return only this export, including its signed download URL when the render is complete. UUID string.

limit.description: Maximum exports to return when exportId is absent (1-50).

offset.description: Export offset when exportId is absent.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: exports_caption_track_get
tools.description: Read a WebVTT caption track from the completed export's immutable canonical speech snapshot, preserving the actual export trims. Returns unavailable for older exports or unverified speech; never fabricates captions from titles or current edited timelines.

tools.name: editor_asset_replace
tools.description: Replace one shot's media asset while preserving the other timeline items. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default. Requires a current editor snapshot and an asset in the same workspace.

tools.name: editor_audio_set
tools.description: Adjust one item's volume and audio fades. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default. Preserves the rest of the project.

tools.name: editor_text_set
tools.description: Create or revise one title or text overlay with explicit timing. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default. This edits project text, not spoken audio or captions.

tools.name: editor_composition_edit
tools.description: Edit composition elements by stable element ID from the editor snapshot: text content, style and animation. Content/style edits preserve placement timing. Optional edit.structure runs ordered insert/move/remove operations before changes. Group by inserting a group and moving children into it. Supply new unique IDs; beforeId null appends. Move coordinates preserveLocal keeps local style and frame offsets, not world position/time. Remove deletes the subtree. Preview reports affected and removed element IDs. Optional edit.duration sets source frames with explicit placements policy: preserve keeps visible windows and syncs unused tails; resizeAll preserves starts/trims and resizes all active placements. Source windows must fit; invalid shortening is rejected. Shared content changes affect all its placements. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears a style override; animation values replace the whole property's animation. Attached presets require explicit detachment. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default.

zoom.description: Zoom of the photo inside its box; 1 fills the box. style.objectPosition pans it.

__schema170.description: Text only: styled character ranges; null clears them

__schema172.description: Image only: the new photo source, e.g. asset:<id>

tools.name: editor_crop_set
tools.description: Adjust the crop of one existing source view after a layout has been applied. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default. Preserves the other shots.

tools.name: editor_assets_insert
tools.description: Insert a workspace image, generated shot or audio asset at an explicit project time. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default.

tools.name: editor_items_move
tools.description: Move selected timeline items to explicit times and layers. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default.

tools.name: editor_items_remove
tools.description: Remove selected timeline items and, if requested, their linked captions. Revision checked; dryRun previews by default. The saved action can be undone.

tools.name: editor_snapshot_get
tools.description: Read the current revision, stable timeline IDs, captions, style and bounded media context before a precise revision. Signed media links are refreshed by reading again.

tools.name: editor_history_list
tools.description: Read up to 50 saved edit actions, their labels and undo state. Does not restore or change the project.

tools.name: editor_edit_undo
tools.description: Restore one saved editor action at the expected current revision. Requires the action ID from edit history and an idempotency key. Existing project data is changed.

tools.name: clips_candidates_list
tools.description: Read existing suggested moments with source ranges, hooks, transcript excerpts and thumbnails before producing videos. Results are bounded; this does not generate suggestions or render clips.

tools.name: captions_words_list
tools.description: Read bounded editable caption words and stable word IDs for one project, optionally matching text.

tools.name: captions_words_correct
tools.description: Replace selected caption words by their stable IDs. Preserves timing and the other captions; this does not change the spoken audio.

tools.name: video_feedback_save
tools.description: Save the user's 1-5 rating and optional quality category/comment against one completed playable video export. Replaces that user's previous feedback for this export; does not change accepted clips or defaults. Requires the feedback storage migration to be installed.

tools.name: captions_source_prepare
tools.description: Restore editable project captions from the selected source's completed canonical transcript. Keeps the full recording and avoids duplicate captions on identical retries. Requires source transcription first; no-speech is an explicit successful state.

tools.name: clips_recover
tools.description: Recover a terminal batch's missing clip count through the persisted recovery workflow. Preserves accepted clips and returns the recovery batch ID. Can spend existing account credits; retry with the identical idempotency key.

tools.name: workspaces_list
tools.description: List bounded workspaces the connected user belongs to, with their role and default workspace. Selecting a workspace for the task does not change account defaults.

tools.name: workspace_context_get
tools.description: Read the selected workspace's business audience, offer, reviewed brand defaults, protected vocabulary, editorial purpose, language, avoided terms, pronunciation notes and existing account entitlements. Returns current export quality, watermark constraints, public plan names, monthly USD prices, included AI credits and the pricing upgrade URL.

tools.name: workspace_context_save
tools.description: Save the user-reviewed business name, audience, offer, conversion goal, tone, protected vocabulary and editorial preferences for the selected workspace. Requires workspace settings permission and confirmReviewed=true; changes future assistant guidance, preserving existing projects. Pronunciation notes guide script drafting; they do not retime or replace source speech.

tools.name: workspace_brand_scan
tools.description: Start extracting a brand profile from the exact website the user supplied and authorized to scan. Saves a draft profile for review; does not apply discovered fields to existing videos. Can spend existing account credits.

tools.name: workspace_brand_scan_get
tools.description: Read one authorized website extraction run and its draft business profile. Show the extracted fields to the user for review before saving them as defaults.

tools.name: media_list
tools.description: List media files in user's library (videos, audio, images)

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (1-50)

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_transcript_get
tools.description: Get transcript summary metadata or a bounded window of transcription segments for a video asset.

assetId.description: The media asset ID to get transcript for. UUID string.

mode.description: Summary returns metadata only. Text returns joined text for a bounded segment window. Full returns the bounded segment objects without duplicating their text.

tools.name: projects_create
tools.description: Create a new private BlitzReels video project.

seriesId.description: Optional Series UUID for this new project.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: media_upload_file
tools.description: Import a video, audio, or image file from ChatGPT into the BlitzReels media library. Use this for a file the user attached or picked, and for an image ChatGPT generated in this conversation that the user wants to keep, animate, or edit in BlitzReels.

file.description: A file from ChatGPT: attached by the user, picked from their file library, or produced earlier in this conversation. ChatGPT provides this value.

name.description: Optional name to use in BlitzReels.

projectId.description: Optional BlitzReels project ID to associate with the uploaded file. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_import_url
tools.description: Import video, audio, images, fonts, SVG or JSON from a direct URL into the private workspace library. Returns a durable asset ID and verified contentHashSha256. Fonts, SVG and JSON are limited to 25 MiB.

url.description: URL of the media file to download and upload

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate the upload with. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

contentHashSha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256; mismatching bytes are rejected before deduplication. 64-character hex string.

tools.name: media_upload_start
tools.description: Get a presigned URL for direct file upload (for large files)

fileName.description: Name of the file to upload

contentType.description: MIME type (e.g., video/mp4, audio/mp3, image/jpeg, font/woff2, image/svg+xml, application/json)

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate the upload with. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_upload_finish
tools.description: Verify uploaded bytes and save a reusable workspace asset after presigned PUT. Returns contentHashSha256, fileSizeBytes and mimeType.

storageKey.description: Storage key for the uploaded file

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes

contentHashSha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256; mismatching bytes are rejected before deduplication. 64-character hex string.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to associate the upload with. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID when projectId is not provided. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_import_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a user-provided public social-video or Google Drive URL and return available import metadata without creating media.

url.description: Public video URL. Supports social video links and Google Drive file links.

tools.name: media_import_scan_page
tools.description: Scan a user-controlled public page and return an importable video URL found on it without creating media.

url.description: Video page URL or direct media URL to inspect for an importable video.

confirmAuthorizedToScan.description: Set true only after the user confirms they control the page or are authorized to scan it.

tools.name: clips_presets_list
tools.description: List available clip batch presets and their clipping/caption defaults.

tools.name: captions_themes_list
tools.description: List built-in caption looks and saved caption themes available to a workspace.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_narration_get
tools.description: Read retained voice inputs, measured duration, audio SHA-256 and word timing. Defaults to 200 words, maximum 500; offset selects the next page. take is null for audio without a retained narration take.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: media_assets_get
tools.description: Get metadata and processing state for one media-library asset without returning transcript segments.

tools.name: media_assets_preview
tools.description: Return one bounded JPEG as MCP image content for visual inspection. Images use the stored visual; videos use the existing thumbnail.

maxDimension.description: Maximum preview width or height in pixels (256-1536).

tools.name: media_folders_list
tools.description: List one bounded level of media-library folders and direct asset counts.

workspaceId.description: Workspace UUID, or null for the default workspace. UUID string.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder UUID, or null for root folders.

tools.name: media_folders_create
tools.description: Create one media-library folder in a workspace and return a retry-safe mutation receipt.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder UUID, or null for the root.

workspaceId.description: Workspace UUID, or null for the default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: media_assets_update
tools.description: Rename one media asset, edit its description, move it to a folder, or change B-roll eligibility. Provide at least one of name, description, folderId, or allowUsingAsBroll.

description.description: New description, or null to clear it.

folderId.description: Target folder UUID, or null to move the asset to root.

allowUsingAsBroll.description: Whether the asset may be selected as B-roll.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: media_upscale_estimate
tools.description: Estimate ByteDance upscale eligibility and credits for one stored video. Does not spend credits or queue a job. Call this before media_upscale.

assetId.description: Source video asset UUID. UUID string.

projectId.description: Optional project UUID for the estimate context. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: media_upscale
tools.description: Queue a ByteDance upscale of one stored video asset to 1080p or 4k. Call media_upscale_estimate first. Spends AI credits and returns a new pending media asset to poll with media_assets_get.

assetId.description: Source video asset UUID. UUID string.

projectId.description: Optional project UUID to attach the credit spend. UUID string.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: clips_create
tools.description: Create a private BlitzReels clip batch from an existing asset or a user-provided video URL. Supports public social videos, Google Drive, and direct media URLs.

seriesId.description: Optional Series UUID. Omitted inherits the source Series; null creates standalone clips.

assetId.description: Existing BlitzReels video asset ID. Provide assetId or url, not both. UUID string.

url.description: Video URL to import before clipping. Supports social video links, Google Drive file links, and direct video file URLs.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

clipPresetId.description: Clip style preset. Use high-retention for High Retention clips or demo-focus for product and screen demos.

createSharePage.description: Create a public showcase page where completed clips appear.

captionThemeId.description: Saved theme UUID or built-in caption look. Omitted inherits Series defaults; null uses workspace captions.

selectedAudioLanguage.description: Audio language track for a social-video URL, using the language reported by media_import_inspect. Null uses source default. Existing assets and direct files preserve source audio.

clipCount.description: Maximum clips requested. Available source moments and account limits can yield fewer.

selection.description: Existing asset only: reviewed candidate IDs to include in order or exclude. Resolve IDs with clips_candidates_list first. Null delegates selection.

durationBounds.description: Requested clip duration bounds. Selection preserves complete moments; minimum cannot exceed maximum.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: clips_get
tools.description: Get status, generated clips, render counts, and download links for a BlitzReels clip batch.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: clip_batches_delete
tools.description: Preview or delete a terminal clip batch. Dry-run is the default; real deletion requires explicit confirmation, retention choice, workspace delete permission, and an idempotency key.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_status_get
tools.description: Read one existing batch's progress, ready clips and renewed signed links without opening or remounting a review widget. Safe for bounded polling and widget refresh; does not recreate or repair clips.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_list
tools.description: List bounded managed clips from the selected source or project with their current workflow state.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_inspect
tools.description: Read one managed clip's selected source range, project, workflow state and delivery information.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_reselect
tools.description: Replace the source moment for one managed clip using a verified suggestion or explicit time range. Can spend existing account credits. Preserves the other clips; read current state before retrying.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_repair
tools.description: Request a layout repair for one managed clip, such as preserving a screen demo or moving captions away from faces. Changes that clip's project; preserves the other clips.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: clips_export
tools.description: Render one managed clip at an existing-account-supported quality. Returns persisted export state; inspect until the accepted delivery file is ready. Can spend existing account credits.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: captions_look_apply
tools.description: Apply a verified caption look to one project. Preserves word overrides unless clearWordOverrides=true. Existing captions are restyled; spoken audio is preserved.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

tools.name: visuals_apply
tools.description: Create or update up to 20 visual blocks in one call after edit timing is settled. Presets: broll-headline, steps, quote, end-screen, key-number, before-after, screenshot-focus, chapter. IDs are scoped to the project; repeating an ID updates it. Asset IDs must belong to the workspace. Atomic, undoable; dryRun validates without writing. Returns IDs and revision. No generation pass.

text.description: Heading, or quote. Max 120 characters except quote: 220.

accentColor.description: Brand accent for key-number or screenshot-focus.

logoAssetId.description: Required for end-screen; null for no logo.

suffix.description: Required for key-number; empty string allowed.

focus.description: Required for screenshot-focus. Normalized rectangle inside the source image.

items.description: Supply only the fields for the selected preset.

tools.name: update_timeline_clip
tools.description: Update one timeline item's start, duration, trim, layer, ignored state, or blurred background. Provide at least one field to update besides timelineItemId.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: batch_update_timeline_clips
tools.description: Update timing, trim, layer, or state for up to 100 timeline items in one sequence transaction.

updates.description: Each update needs at least one field to change besides timelineItemId.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: mute_clip_audio
tools.description: Set one timeline media item's volume to zero.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: delete_timeline_items
tools.description: Preview or delete up to 100 timeline items and optionally remove linked captions.

tools.name: add_text_overlay
tools.description: Add an opening title card (hook) or generic text overlay to a project timeline. Defaults to classic white: black text on a white card.

kind.description: title_card is an opening hook. lower_third is a speaker label (name and role on separate lines). overlay is generic on-video text.

theme.description: Title-card look. classic_white is black text on a white card. Ignored for overlay.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: add_transition
tools.description: Add a timed transition effect, optionally attached to one timeline item and paired with sound.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: timeline_media_add
tools.description: Place an image or video asset onto a BlitzReels project timeline at a timestamp, including B-roll and static images.

assetId.description: Image or video media asset ID. UUID string.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds. Required for still images when a specific length is needed.

layerIndex.description: Exact timeline layer to use. Lower layer numbers render on top. Omit for intent-based placement.

placementIntent.description: Layer intent used when layerIndex is omitted. Use overlay for visible B-roll/logo/sticker over video, background for behind video, exact when layerIndex is supplied.

allowDuplicate.description: Allow inserting the same asset more than once

tools.name: timeline_audio_add
tools.description: Place an audio asset onto a BlitzReels project timeline at a timestamp for voiceover, music, or sound.

assetId.description: Audio media asset ID. UUID string.

durationSeconds.description: Optional duration. Required if the audio asset duration is not known yet.

loop.description: Loop audio to fill requested duration

tools.name: exports_start
tools.description: Export a BlitzReels video or native carousel and return export and job IDs for status checks.

expectedRevision.description: Reject export if the Project changed since this revision was read.

format.description: Video container or native carousel image ZIP format

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_options_list
tools.description: List models, defaults, limits and credit costs for one generation kind. For a selected video model, pass videoQuote with its model, seconds and optional resolution to check the workspace's current eligibility and a shorter option when available. Durations come from durations_seconds. A quote spends no credits and reserves no capacity.

tools.name: generation_image_create
tools.description: Queue an AI image generation into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

prompt.description: What the image should show (8-5000 characters).

model.description: Image model. Call generation_options_list for costs.

resolution.description: Native image resolution. Call generation_options_list for model support and resolution pricing. Unsupported settings are rejected.

characterId.description: Workspace character to keep consistent (characters_list). Its reference images or trained weights and description are added; they count toward the model reference limit.

size.description: Exact output size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, for example 1920x2304. Only models whose parameters.size.supported is true in generation_options_list; it replaces aspectRatio, and credits scale with pixel count.

background.description: Background of the generated image: auto (the model decides), opaque or transparent (an RGBA PNG for cut-outs and overlays). Only models whose parameters.background.supported is true in generation_options_list accept opaque or transparent.

referenceAssetIds.description: Ordered image references. Model-specific limits are listed in generation_options_list; unsupported references fail.

enhancePrompt.description: Enhance using BlitzReels model grammar and actual input context.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_video_create
tools.description: Queue video generation, image animation, source-video editing or character replacement into the media library. Spends AI credits. Check the selected model and duration first with generation_options_list and videoQuote. Editing accepts referenceVideoAssetIds and transformation controls, including original-audio preservation. Read the queued job with generation_jobs_get.

provenance.description: Original user request before prompt authoring, and previous failed job ID when retrying. Retained for review; never infer missing wording.

prompt.description: What should happen in the shot (3-5000 characters).

model.description: Video model. generation_options_list publishes generation type, source limits, character controls, resolution and pricing for each model.

durationSeconds.description: Video transformations inherit the processed source duration and aspect ratio; duration_seconds is not a trim request. Choose a value from the selected model's durations_seconds. duration_seconds_min and duration_seconds_max are the bounds of that list, not a continuous range.

sourceAssetId.description: First-frame still. Required only when that model's parameters.source_asset_id.required is true. Optional on reference-capable I2V including Seedance 2.5. Text-to-video rejects it. Cannot combine with reference arrays and end_frame_asset_id.

referenceAssetIds.description: Ordered reference images: Seedance 2.5 up to 30; Seedance 2.0 ref2v up to 9; other reference models up to 4. Source counts toward the limit.

characterId.description: Workspace character to keep consistent (characters_list). Its reference images come first (@Image1 is the primary), capped to the model limit. Only models whose parameters.character_id.supported is true in generation_options_list.

referenceVideoRange.description: Cut this range from the reference video before a character swap or video edit; billed for the range length. Seconds, or phrases spoken in the source transcript (cut in the pauses around them; each phrase must occur once).

referenceAssetUris.description: BytePlus ModelArk real-human assets as asset://ID, for people who verified themselves in the BytePlus console. Requires provider byteplus-modelark and a model whose parameters.reference_asset_uris.supported is true in generation_options_list. They follow referenceAssetIds in @ImageN numbering and count toward the reference limit.

intent.description: What the edit changes: swap (people, needs characters), scene (environment), camera (angle or framing) or style. Omitted: inferred from the prompt.

output.description: With reference_video_range: range returns only the edited range (default); full splices it back into the whole source video with its original audio.

transition.description: Seam between the source and a spliced range when output is full: cut (default) or a short crossfade.

lookFrameAssetId.description: Image of the first frame after the change, approved before paying for the video (create one with POST /generate-look-frame). Sent as @Image1 so the edit matches its look. Video edit models only; counts toward their reference image limit.

referenceVideoAssetIds.description: Video transformations require one processed source video. Other reference modes have model-specific counts published by generation_options_list.

referenceAudioAssetIds.description: Reference audio: Seedance 2.5 up to 10; Seedance 2.0 ref2v and fast up to 3. Other models reject them.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Call generation_options_list for model-specific supported values and defaults. Unsupported settings are rejected.

generateAudio.description: null uses model audio behavior. Explicit true/false must be supported by the selected model.

negativePrompt.description: What to avoid in the shot.

enhancePrompt.description: Enhance using BlitzReels model grammar and actual input context.

endFrameAssetId.description: Last-frame still. Interpolates from the source first frame to this image across the full duration. Requires a source first frame; cannot combine with reference arrays.

provider.description: Explicit provider must support the model and input mode. auto uses a configured compatible provider.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_voiceover_create
tools.description: Queue a text-to-speech voiceover into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

voiceId.description: Catalog voice ID (generation_options_list with kind voiceover) or a workspace voice ID (voices_list), such as a cloned voice.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_music_create
tools.description: Queue a background music track into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_sound_create
tools.description: Queue a sound effect into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

promptInfluence.description: How literally to follow the prompt, between 0 and 1. Higher is more literal.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_faceless_create
tools.description: Prepare a storyboard for a faceless video with optional voiceover, captions, music and sound. Poll generation_jobs_get for the storyboard, then use video_storyboard_get to review the scenes and estimated cost before approving production. Planning spends AI credits.

script.description: The narration or story to turn into a video.

projectName.description: Name for the created BlitzReels project.

visualStyle.description: Optional art direction override. A Story Kit style is used when omitted.

seriesId.description: Optional Series UUID. Inherits its Story Kit and branding defaults for this new video.

storyKitId.description: Reusable Story Kit UUID for characters, references, locations, style, and narrator voice.

plannerModelId.description: Model used to plan the video scenes.

imageModelId.description: Model used to generate scene images.

videoModel.description: Image-to-video model used to animate scenes.

generateVoiceover.description: Narrate the script with a generated voice.

voiceId.description: Optional voice override from the BlitzReels voice catalog. The Story Kit narrator voice is used when omitted.

captionStyleId.description: Optional caption theme ID from captions_themes_list.

styleReferenceAssetIds.description: Optional stills that lock rendering medium, palette, lighting and texture. Not used as scene frames.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key. Reuse only with identical inputs.

tools.name: generation_jobs_get
tools.description: Read generation status, failure category, ledger-confirmed credit outcome, prompt history and compatible model alternatives. Alternatives report duration splits, estimated credits and unverified acceptance. reviewUrl opens prompt review and support escalation. Completed media jobs include the asset when available. A completed faceless planning job returns a storyboard revision for review before video production.

jobId.description: Job ID returned by any generation_*_create tool.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: generation_jobs_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of the identified queued or running generation. Work already performed can consume credits; cancellation does not establish a refund.

jobId.description: Job ID returned by any generation_*_create tool.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace ID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: generation_plan_brief
tools.description: Read a generation brief from rawPrompt. Source-video edits return execution for generation_video_create with required assets and transformation controls. New scenes return an authoring grammar and planJsonSchema for generation_plan_validate. The video creation provenance.originalRequest field retains rawPrompt when supplied. This read does not generate media or spend credits.

rawPrompt.description: Original request. Clone or character-replacement requests select a video transformation brief instead of a new-story plan.

videoModelId.description: Target video model id (see generation_options_list, kind: video). Defaults to the strongest single-take model.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Desired final video duration in seconds.

visualStyle.description: Visual style preset id; its locked style contract is included in the brief.

genre.description: Genre pack id (e.g. pixar-culture-skit). The brief lists available ids in availableGenres; the pack's beats and visual contract override the generic grammar.

tools.name: generation_plan_validate
tools.description: Validate a self-authored generation plan against the schema and the target model's real capabilities before execution. Returns directive errors to fix and revalidate; only a valid plan is executable.

plan.description: The generation plan object authored from generation_plan_brief's planJsonSchema.

tools.name: characters_list
tools.description: List bounded reusable characters with identity, voice, facts, and image-reference metadata.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: characters_get
tools.description: Inspect one reusable character and its ordered reference-image set before planning a story.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: characters_apply
tools.description: Create or update a reference-based character for repeatable faceless story generation.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

confirmRightsToReferences.description: Set true only after the user confirms they own the reference media or have permission to use it.

confirmLikenessConsent.description: For a human character, set true only after the user confirms consent to use the depicted person's likeness.

tools.name: story_kits_list
tools.description: List bounded reusable Story Kits that bind characters, locations, style, facts, and narrator voice.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: story_kits_get
tools.description: Inspect one Story Kit and its revision before generating or updating a story.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: story_kits_apply
tools.description: Create or update a Story Kit with optimistic concurrency and an idempotent mutation receipt.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace UUID. Defaults to the user's default workspace. UUID string.

tools.name: series_list
tools.description: List optional Series with bounded counts and cover previews.

tools.name: series_get
tools.description: Read a Series identity, creative defaults and revision.

tools.name: series_content
tools.description: List sources or projects in a Series. Null seriesId lists standalone content. sourceId filters projects by clip origin.

tools.name: series_apply
tools.description: Create or replace a Growth+ Series identity and defaults. defaultCreationMode selects podcast branding or faceless Story Kit defaults; membership stays mixed. Updates require expectedRevision. Existing content keeps its settings.

tools.name: series_assign
tools.description: Assign, move or detach one source or project using expectedSeriesId. Moving a source does not move existing clips or change branding.

tools.name: series_delete
tools.description: Delete the Series container at an expected revision and detach its content. Sources, projects and exports are preserved.

tools.name: customer_measurements_list
tools.description: Read observed link clicks and self-reported outcomes in a bounded window up to 90 days. Counts are not verified conversions. Provider engagement remains separate.

tools.name: customer_link_apply
tools.description: Create a stable HTTPS tracking link or revise its label/enabled state. Destination and content association are immutable. Revisions require expectedRevision; null creates.

tools.name: customer_outcome_apply
tools.description: Record or revise leads, sales, revenue or another measured outcome with source, time and explicit attribution. Revision history is retained; voided records remain visible. No conversion is inferred from clicks.

tools.name: learning_quote
tools.description: Read bounded Series feedback, metrics, clicks and self-reported outcomes with current owner direction and a cost quote. No model call. Missing or incomparable evidence remains explicit.

tools.name: learning_start
tools.description: Start one bounded model call from a reviewed learning quote and approved credits/USD cap. Saves cited lessons and up to five experimental briefs in the shared brain. Idempotent; never publishes or promises performance.

tools.name: learning_get
tools.description: Read frozen evidence, exact creative lineage, progress and saved lessons for a workspace learning job. Current owner direction overrides saved suggestions.

tools.name: learning_control
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running analysis, recover an unconfirmed dispatch by its existing identity, or deliver a retained result. Resume never repeats an uncertain model call and rejects changed owner direction.

tools.name: carousels_board_get
tools.description: Read a carousel board: revision, caption, pending AI images and a summary of every slide with its elements in paint order (ID, type, parent, text, image source, box in slide pixels, font, color, hidden, locked), plus the brand theme and saved themes. carousels_board_edit targets these IDs and theme ids. view full adds the board composition (editor element model; colors may be brand tokens like var(--br-accent); media sources are asset:<id>, brand:logo or bundled paths). slideIds limits the summary to those slides.

slideIds.description: Only these slides in the summary; null returns every slide

tools.name: carousels_board_templates
tools.description: List carousel slide templates: id, family, label and slots (key, kind text or image, sample). carousels_board_edit insertTemplateSlide takes a template id and slot values.

tools.name: carousels_board_edit
tools.description: Apply ordered operations to a carousel board by slide and element ID: add a slide from a template with its text and photos, change text and style, insert, duplicate, move or remove slides, set the theme, apply the brand or a saved theme, hide or lock an element. Operations apply to the latest board unless expectedRevision is set; dryRun saves nothing. Returns the base and new revision, affected IDs, slide order and a summary of each changed slide; errors name the failing operation. Identical idempotency keys replay.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.

expectedRevision.description: Null (default) applies the operations to the latest board. A revision rejects the edit with a conflict when the board has moved.

dryRun.description: Apply to the latest board without saving and return the would-be result.

items.description: Applied in order. Every operation is a flat object with its kind, e.g. {"kind":"edit","edit":{"changes":[{"elementId":"slide-1-headline","content":"New hook"}]}} or {"kind":"layoutSlides","slideIds":null,"align":"center"}. insertTemplateSlide {templateId, values: {slotKey: text or asset:<id>}, index (null appends), slideId (null picks slide-N)}; applyTheme {themeId: 'brand' or a saved theme id from carousels_board_get}; edit {edit: {changes: [{elementId, content (text), runs (text), src (image: asset:<id>), style}], structure}} where style values of null remove an override; swap a photo with src on its image element, never by rebuilding the slide; insertSlide {index, slide: group element}; duplicateSlide {slideId, idSuffix}; moveSlide {slideId, index}; removeSlide {slideId}; setTheme {theme}; setLayer {elementId, hidden and/or locked (an omitted flag keeps its state)}; layoutSlides {slideIds (null = every slide), align: left|center|right, textScale: e.g. 1.1} aligns text blocks and scales text on any slide; placeImages {slideId, images: [{src: asset:<id>, name}], area: top|center|bottom|top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right, height (null fits)} lines up images or logos on a slide; showPart {part: logo|swipe|texture, visible, slideIds (null = every slide)}.

tools.name: carousels_board_generate
tools.description: Write and design a full carousel from a prompt into the project board: hook, body slides, ending call to action and a post caption, styled with the brand kit or a preset style, with optional AI photos (photos finish in the background; pendingAssetIds lists them). Replaces the current board and renames the project. Uses AI and image credits; a retry with the same idempotency key and input replays the first result without generating or charging again.

expectedRevision.description: Replace the board only at this revision; null replaces the latest board.

slideCount.description: Total slides including cover and call to action; null lets the prompt decide.

style.description: Ready-made look; null keeps the carousel's current look.

imageModelId.description: Image model for the generated photos; null uses Nano Banana 2. Ignored when withImages is false.

characterIds.description: Saved AI characters to cast in the photos, by id; their saved references keep their faces. Empty lets the prompt decide.

places.description: Saved places to set the photos in (a Story Kit location); their reference photo keeps the same room. Empty lets the prompt decide.

sourceUrl.description: A public web page the carousel is about (full URL or domain); its text grounds the slides. Null reads a web address written in the prompt, if any.

tools.name: carousels_board_ideas
tools.description: Recommend six carousel ideas from the workspace brand brief, each with a cover hook, angle, goal (grow, convert or both), archetype and why it should perform. Pass one to carousels_board_generate as its prompt.

tools.name: carousels_board_image
tools.description: Start one AI photo shaped for the board (slide or square) and return its asset:<id> source. The image finishes in the background; place it with carousels_board_edit right away, it appears once ready. Uses image credits.

tools.name: carousels_board_versions
tools.description: List saved versions of a carousel board, newest first (revision, source: baseline, editor, agent, api, generation or restore; author, merged change count, slide count), or with versionId read one version as a board summary. Saves by the same author and source within three minutes share one version; the newest 50 are kept.

tools.name: carousels_board_version_restore
tools.description: Replace a carousel board with a saved version from carousels_board_versions as a new revision; every version stays in the history, so a restore can itself be undone by restoring another. Replaces the latest board unless expectedRevision is set. Identical idempotency keys replay.

tools.name: carousels_compile
tools.description: Create or replace a carousel project from a slide document. Server owns chip layout, safezones, and exact export pixels.

tools.name: carousels_preview
tools.description: Render and store private JPEG previews for the selected carousel slides. Replaces cached previews at deterministic storage keys; preserves the source project and slide document.

tools.name: carousels_get
tools.description: Read the carousel slot document and the named template catalog.

tools.name: carousels_patch_slide
tools.description: Patch native slots/media or select a completed Remotion frame artifact and crop. Requires expectedRevision; identical keys replay.

tools.name: carousels_expand_recipe
tools.description: Turn a named recipe or a brief into compile-ready named-template slides. Expand never publishes and never invents metrics.

tools.name: carousels_migrate
tools.description: Rebuild a compile slot document from a legacy overlay carousel. Then patch slots like any compiled deck.

tools.name: carousels_clone
tools.description: Duplicate a carousel onto a new project. Copies slots. Icon and shot values may be pack filenames or asset:<media_asset_id>.

tools.name: publishing_connections_list
tools.description: List Instagram accounts connected through the BlitzReels UI for the authenticated workspace, including their connection status.

tools.name: publishing_instagram_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a completed project export to Instagram. Optional includeAffiliateCta appends Try BlitzReels for free plus the Affonso tracking URL. Requires an active Instagram account connected in the BlitzReels UI.

exportId.description: Completed export UUID. Defaults to latest completed. UUID string.

connectionId.description: Instagram connection UUID when multiple exist.

scheduledFor.description: ISO-8601 datetime for the scheduled publish.

shareToFeed.description: Also share Reel to profile feed.

includeAffiliateCta.description: Append Try BlitzReels for free plus Affonso tracking URL.

affiliateTrackingUrl.description: Optional BlitzReels URL with via/ref/aff override.

tools.name: publishing_accounts_list
tools.description: Read the supported accounts available through the existing workspace and provider access rules. Does not connect new accounts, publish, schedule or bypass provider review.

tools.name: publishing_video_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a selected existing video asset to explicit active YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn or Threads accounts connected in the BlitzReels UI, using reviewed copy, privacy/consent choices, synthetic-media disclosure, time and timezone. Requires confirmPublish=true. Existing workspace permissions and provider access rules apply. A scheduled receipt is not proof of publication.

tools.name: publishing_post_get
tools.description: Read the current targets for one publishing receipt with scheduled/published state and verified remote URLs. Does not retry or publish a failed target.

tools.name: timeline_trim_preview
tools.description: Preview trimming or extending one timeline item without changing the project.

tools.name: timeline_trim_apply
tools.description: Trim or extend one timeline item at the expected project revision. Changes existing timeline state and returns a retry-safe receipt.

tools.name: timeline_split_preview
tools.description: Preview splitting one timeline item without changing the project.

tools.name: timeline_split_apply
tools.description: Split one timeline item at the expected project revision. Changes existing timeline state and returns a retry-safe receipt.

tools.name: carousels_slides_reorder
tools.description: Move one carousel slide to a new index. Replaces the existing slide order.

tools.name: carousels_slides_remove
tools.description: Remove one carousel slide and its content from the project.

tools.name: carousels_slides_insert
tools.description: Insert one new carousel slide from a named template or copy an existing slide. Preserves existing slide content.

tools.name: carousels_slides_undo
tools.description: Restore the previous carousel document revision, replacing the current slide document.

tools.name: carousels_save_theme
tools.description: Save and activate the current carousel styling as a private theme; removes the oldest saved theme when the 40-theme limit is reached.

tools.name: carousels_apply_theme
tools.description: Replace this carousel's styling with an existing saved theme.

tools.name: carousels_delete_theme
tools.description: Delete one saved private carousel theme.

tools.name: carousels_save_template
tools.description: Save one carousel slide as a private template; removes the oldest saved template when the 40-template limit is reached.

tools.name: carousels_apply_template
tools.description: Replace one carousel slide with a saved private template.

tools.name: carousels_delete_template
tools.description: Delete one saved private carousel slide template.

tools.name: carousels_apply_brand
tools.description: Replace this carousel's styling with the workspace's saved brand theme.

tools.name: clips_delivery_promote
tools.description: Make one completed export the accepted delivery for a clip after explicit visual-QA confirmation. Replaces the delivery pointer and preserves earlier exports.

workspaceId.description: UUID string.
